findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the ice machine baffles have an accumulation of debris. The ice machine must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. The inspector will follow-up on 9/8/2025 to check that the ice baffles have been cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the ice machine scoop was stored with the handle touching the ice. The PIC was informed and the ice scoop was moved during the inspection. Ensure that scoops for ready-to-eat foods are stored with the handles above the top of food to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(A) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) Except as specified under (B) of this section, in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed there is a gap between the hand washing sink and the wall. Ensure that the hand washing sink is sealed to the wall (ex.caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.
